rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for the raspberry fruit.

example.jyutping: ni1 nap1 fuk1 pun4 zi2 hou2 tim4

rows.note: Use this specifically for the living raspberry plant rather than its fruit.

example.english: This raspberry plant is one I bought at the flower market.
example.traditional: 呢棵覆盆子樹係我喺花墟買嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 fo2 fuk1 pun4 zi2 syu6 hai6 ngo5 hai2 faa1 heoi1 maai5 ge3

rows.note: Use this when the sound is being made as a humorous imitation of a fart or to show derision.

example.english: I pulled a face and made a raspberry at them.
example.traditional: 我扮鬼臉對住佢整咗個放屁聲。
example.jyutping: ngo5 baan6 gwai2 lim5 deoi3 zyu6 keoi5 zing2 zo2 go3 fong3 pei3 sing1

rows.note: Use this botanical term for other Rubus plants, especially in a plant-identification context.

example.english: The plant guide says this raspberry species is an introduced one.
example.traditional: 植物圖鑑話呢種懸鉤子係外來品種。
example.jyutping: zik6 mat6 tou4 gaam3 waa6 ni1 zung2 jyun4 ngau1 zi2 hai6 ngoi6 loi4 ban2 zung2
